title: Clearwater Lakes
html:
Clearwater Lakes is a North American map added to OpenFront in Update 33.0 by RickD004 — Double impact crater lakes in Canada.

Nations

The map features 13 named nations, including Atkinson Island, Kamiskutanikaw Island, Lepage Island, Mantunikw Island, Lake Donat and Lake Ichikami.

Details

  • Categories: North America
  • Nations: 13
  • Public rotation frequency: 3
